name: Perplexity
summary: AI answer engine with cited sources, deep research and multiple top models.
description: Perplexity answers questions with web search and cited sources, and offers deep research, a choice of top AI models (e.g. GPT-6.1 Sol, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Grok 4.7, Kimi K3) and 'Computer', which creates documents, apps and tools. Users can sign up for free; Pro costs $17/month billed annually and adds expanded Computer access, deep research and model selection, while Max costs $167/month billed annually with maximum usage and frontier models. It also makes the free Comet browser.
